eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 9:49 AM on AUG 30, 2024 Effective until 7:49 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police Department is looking for Erasmo Rangel last seen on foot near third street and Roeser road wearing a black cap, cream and black flannel shirt and khaki pants. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
